roles.role: Research, script, animation code and music code
roles.detail: Every fact traced to a cited source; every line, shot and Strudel cue written at high reasoning effort. Anthropic is a lab in this story, held to the same sources and standard as every other.
A library voice chosen by audition; not a clone or imitation of any real person.
Speech-to-text round trip on every name the voice might mangle.
Composed as live-coding patterns by Claude and rendered with Strudel’s own Export to WAV. Each cue’s source opens in strudel.cc from the film page.
Lamp clicks, match strikes and stamps generated by generator/film/lib/foley.mjs; no sample libraries.
Painted live, frame by frame; the shelf plays the same code that renders the film.
